theses.subject: Telecom & Utilities
theses.thesis: Low-beta income complex is scorable only in spirit; its durability_bar (0.48) is modest and non-eligible, but it sits mid-pack with breadth 0.583 — the only non-top theme with a trend tag and reasonable participation. In a tape where the absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg and the leader is thin-margined banks, a defensive income tilt is the only falsifiable stay-in-harness idea that does not rely on momentum rank as alpha.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend with breadth 0.583 suggests participation, not a one-name move
durability_bar 0.48 is above the 0.39/0.36 of other non-top themes, i.e. less fragile
absolute_trend_gate is the one validated drawdown-control leg — a defensive theme respects it
theses.dissent: It is rank 8 and ineligible — this is precisely the kind of contrarian pick the guardrails warn against; it has no momentum anywhere close to leadership and the 'trend' tag may simply be slow yield-chasing that underperforms in a liquidity-driven HK tape.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Rank 4 and eligible with durability 0.65 and breadth 0.75 — this is the least fragile of the eligible names and the only one combining eligibility with broad participation. In a narrowing rotation (frac 0.29) with no clear challenger beyond energy, a broad-based income theme is a stable place to express 'stay in the tape but do not chase the leader'.
evidence: eligible=true with rank 4 — top-quartile presence without the thin bank leadership
durability_bar 0.65 is the best among eligible names
breadth 0.75 implies this is a real group move, not a few crowded names
hurst_tag=trend supports a persistent, not spiky, advance
theses.dissent: Yield names in HK often act as a parking lot for risk-off money; if the broad tape reverses, this underperforms growth-sensitive leadership and the 'durability' is just slow beta, not resilience.
